mentions.name: Chameleon
mentions.description: An automotive-grade controller board running TockOS (written in Rust), designed as a generic control module rather than an engine control unit and built with AEC-qualified parts. Prototype PCBs are on order; the AI-assisted PCB layout was redone three times, with an expected price point around $400.
mentions.source_excerpt: The first prototype PCBs for my automotive grade, TockOS (Rust) running controller are on order.
mentions.author: rta5
